nativeMessaging: Starts and reaches the local Graft daemon (native host); every agent run goes through it.
storage: Chat, run, job and settings state in chrome.storage (local and session), restored when the service worker restarts.
tabs: Opens, reads, moves and closes the agent's tabs and keeps the tab inventory the daemon sees; runs in the background with no user gesture.
sidePanel: The Graft chat lives in Chrome's side panel (Graft extension only).
debugger: CDP is the browser kernel: input, observation, network capture, screenshots and emulation for every browser_code step.
contextMenus: The right-click 'Ask Graft' entries (Graft extension only).
notifications: Tells the user when a background run finishes or needs a hand-off.
userScripts: Site scripts and boosts the user installs run as user scripts in their own world.
scripting: Injects the cursor box, page reads and CSS into tabs the agent works in.
webNavigation: Waits for navigations to commit or fail, so steps settle on the right document.
downloads: browser.downloads list/save and the download archiver bus, called from agent code.
offscreen: The offscreen document records tabs (MediaRecorder), swaps the clipboard for a paste and parses HTML. It evaluates no code.
tabCapture: Records a tab the user or agent asks to record (page.record / takes).
tabGroups: Groups the agent's tabs per chat so the user sees which tabs a run owns.
alarms: Keeps jobs, routines and the daemon link alive across service-worker suspension.
history: browser.history search and visits, called from agent code without a user gesture.
bookmarks: browser.bookmarks search, tree, create, update and remove, called from agent code.
cookies: page.session(), cookie claws and session freeze read and write the user's cookies for the agent.
declarativeNetRequest: Site blocking, page.abort, dry-run shields and request headers for browser.fetch.
contentSettings: page.permissions grants or blocks a site's camera, location and notification prompts during a run.
privacy: Reads and toggles Chrome's password-saving setting so the password vault captures logins.
clipboardRead: The paste step saves the user's clipboard before it pastes and restores it after, in the background.
clipboardWrite: The paste step writes text and HTML to the clipboard for editors that only accept paste.
host_permissions:http://*/*: The agent works on any site the user asks for: scripting, cookies and fetch on that site.
host_permissions:https://*/*: The agent works on any site the user asks for: scripting, cookies and fetch on that site.
